summary: Iteration 5 covered the 4 new features (in_progress lock + completed-only tip / driver Earnings / Inbox tab on both roles / Admin dashboard) plus an automated backend regression. ALL PASSED. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_earnings_inbox_admin.py — 12/12 green (17.7s). Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844 + desktop 1280x800 for /admin): (1) Customer tracking /ride/[id]: ran a full ride end-to-end (rider@getaride.com); when status transitioned to in_progress the sheet showed ONLY 'Sit back and enjoy your ride — trip options return after drop-off.' — testIDs open-chat / call-driver / cancel-trip / tip-3 ALL hidden (chat_hidden=True call_hidden=True cancel_hidden=True tip_hidden=True). After completion the CompletedSheet rendered 'Trip completed' with $22.50 fare, the Add-a-tip section ($3/$5/$10/Custom + No tip) and a Done button (testID trip-done). (2) Driver Earnings tab (driver@getaride.com → 'Earnings'): rendered 'This week $431.50', a 7-bar weekday chart, Online 5.5h / Trips 17 / Points 863 stat row, Wallet balance card '$431.50 — Your lifetime trip earnings, including tips.' (no 'paid automatically' wording — verified by substring check), and the Fare breakdown list (Trip fare + Tip + 'You earned') per trip; no crash. (3) Inbox tab on BOTH roles: appears in the bottom tabbar with chatbubbles icon, shows empty state when no convos, lists rows (testID convo-<rid>) with trash button (testID delete-<rid>), tapping a row navigates to /chat/<rid>, the trash icon (after window.confirm) soft-deletes the row and it disappears from the user's inbox. Driver inbox showed 'Derek T. - Sounds good. - Walt Disney World → Amway Center'. (4) Admin dashboard at /admin: non-admin creds (rider@getaride.com / Ride1234) → error 'This account is not an admin.' rendered correctly; admin@getaride.com / Admin1234 logs in successfully (Overview shows Revenue $6185.00 / Tips $14.00 / Completed 22 / Active 12 / Total 45 / Drivers 11 / Drivers online 10 / Customers 11), all four tabs (admin-tab-overview/conversations/users/rides) switch and render content. Critically, the Conversations tab still showed the 'Demo Rider ↔ Tasha Moore — Lake Eola → MCO' conversation AFTER the customer had soft-deleted it from their own inbox — confirming the admin-sees-everything contract. /api/admin/users response excludes the password field. Console errors: only the pre-existing 3rd-party ipapi.co/json CORS warning (geolocation fallback, NOT a bug); zero React Native red screens, zero JS errors related to the 4 new features.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 706: in inbox(), 'other' uses `(r.get('customer_name') or 'Rider')` for the driver-side label but `assigned_driver.name` for the customer-side. If a customer-created ride was selected via /select, assigned_driver is the SIM driver, not the bidding driver — so the customer's inbox row will display the SIM driver's name (e.g. 'Tasha Moore') even though chat replies come from a different identity. Verified in test as 'Tasha Moore' on customer inbox. Acceptable for the current sim, just flag for future when real assignment lands.

server.py /api/admin/conversations (line 755-773) returns the entire messages[] inline for every ride that has messages. With 8 conversations today this is fine; at 1k+ conversations payload size could balloon. Consider returning ride_id + last message + count, then GET /api/admin/conversations/{id}/messages lazily on expand.

frontend src/components/InboxList.tsx line 36: state is removed BEFORE the DELETE network request is sent. If the DELETE fails (offline, 500), the row is gone from UI but still present server-side until next reload. Consider try/catch with restore-on-failure, or at least toast on failure.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests register fresh TEST_cust_* / TEST_drv_* users each module run. Frontend tests created one new customer ride (id 30b5a78d…) as rider@getaride.com that was driven to completion and a chat message exchanged; subsequently soft-deleted from the customer inbox — admin /admin/conversations still shows it (as required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest module test_earnings_inbox_admin.py uses live seeded admin (admin@getaride.com/Admin1234) — keep that user intact in the seeder. Frontend localStorage stores the auth JWT under key 'token' but JSON-STRINGIFIED (i.e. wrapped in extra quotes); when scripting fetch calls from Playwright use JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('token')) before sending as Bearer. The customer rider@getaride.com may have leftover active rides after each test run; the home screen creates a new one anyway (multi-ride is supported). The admin dashboard stores its token under 'admin_token' but currently /api shares the Authorization header set by the global API helper — running the admin login DOES overwrite the rider's token in the global header, so test admin in its own browser context if you also need rider/driver flows in the same run.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all four new features pass end-to-end on the live preview URL.
